proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_passive_aura
proposed_widenings.justification: The item has a held, always-on emanation that grants an ongoing benefit to the wielder and friendly creatures in the area. Current MagicItemMechanics can express owner-only passives, activations, reactions, and summons, but not a non-spell persistent aura with area attachment and ongoing operations.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While you hold the drawn weapon, it creates a 10-foot Emanation originating from you. You and all creatures Friendly to you in the Emanation have Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_on_hit_trigger
proposed_widenings.justification: The item has a conditional extra-damage rider that resolves when a hit lands with this specific weapon. The current surface only has on-hit rider machinery for mastery records, not reusable magic-item mechanics.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you hit a Fiend or an Undead with it, that creature takes an extra 2d10 Radiant damage.

proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage.sourceFilter = spell_or_magical_effect
proposed_widenings.justification: If the aura family existed, the granted advantage would still need save-source narrowing to magical effects. Current modify_roll_advantage can target saving throws broadly, but not saving throws against spells and other magical effects only.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You and all creatures Friendly to you in the Emanation have Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

proposed_widenings.name: area.shape.threshold_tiers(axis=class)
proposed_widenings.justification: The aura radius scales from 10 feet to 30 feet at paladin level 17. Current area geometry is fixed and cannot encode class-level threshold scaling on attachment size.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you have 17 or more levels in the Paladin class, the size of the Emanation increases to 30 feet.

notes: Did not author content JSON/Dhall because any current encoding would be dishonest. The +3 attack and damage bonuses do fit as passive held-item grants scoped to the specific weapon, but the unit as a whole is blocked by the missing passive-aura and magic-item on-hit-rider structures.
